topics.title: Phone Calls About Race and Diamonds
topics.summary: The show features a chaotic phone-in segment where callers discuss race relations, referencing the KKK. A black caller expresses frustration with perceived ignorance while another discusses his experiences as a truck driver and shares an anecdote about receiving a letter from a fellow Black man. The conversation becomes tangential involving personal opinions on Michael Jackson and romantic preferences.

topics.title: Racial Slurs and a Call About Community College
topics.summary: The broadcast features an extended exchange filled with racial slurs and heated arguments between Howard Stern and callers. A skinhead caller expresses racist views about Black people while another discusses the relevance of community college, leading to further contentious debate.

topics.title: Mystery Guest Interview
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, hosts Howard and Robin attempt to uncover details about an unknown guest through increasingly bizarre questioning, touching on topics from Saddam Hussein to celebrity encounters like Don Kirshner and Tom Cruise. Ultimately, they identify the guest as Michael Nesmith.

topics.title: Don Kirshner Discusses Music and Finances
topics.summary: During an interview, Don Kirshner discusses his career in rock music, including owning recordings of various bands and managing royalties. He shares anecdotes about his daughter's involvement with Chrissy Hynde and reveals a personal story regarding financial challenges within the entertainment industry.

topics.title: Stern and Hall Debate Arsenio’s Finances
